settings.gameLanguage.context: Settings game-text card title and native select label; changes installed-game names only.
settings.gameLanguage.lengthHint: Card title and select label, ideally under 28 characters.

settings.gameLanguageHelp.context: Help below game-text language title; explains installed files and per-entry English fallback.
settings.gameLanguageHelp.lengthHint: Two short lines in a 640 px card.
settings.gameLanguageHelp.tone: Factual; do not promise every name is translated.

settings.unavailable.context: Suffix on a saved language option absent from this installation; leading space is intentional.
settings.unavailable.lengthHint: Short parenthesized suffix inside a select option.

settings.languagesLoading.context: Status below game-text select while installed-language discovery runs.

settings.languagesFailed.context: Status when installed-language discovery fails; saved choice remains selected.
settings.languagesFailed.tone: Reassuring; distinguish discovery from game-text load failure.

settings.languageUnavailable.context: Warning below game-text select for a language absent from the installation.
settings.languageUnavailable.tone: Explain English fallback without implying data loss.

settings.paths.context: Settings card heading for game installation and save profile paths.

settings.gameInstallation.context: Label above read-only game installation path and its accessible input name.

settings.gamePathPlaceholder.context: Placeholder when no game installation path is configured.
settings.gamePathPlaceholder.lengthHint: Single input line; may clip while empty.

settings.browse.context: Both path-row Browse buttons; opens the corresponding native directory picker.
settings.browse.tone: Action verb; distinguish by surrounding path label.

settings.detect.context: Auto-detect buttons in both game and save path rows.

settings.invalidGamePath.context: Inline warning after no valid installation is detected in the game path row.
settings.invalidGamePath.lengthHint: Two wrapping lines below path input.
settings.invalidGamePath.tone: Clear recovery advice; no claim that files were changed.

settings.saveLocation.context: Label above read-only save profile path and its accessible input name.

settings.savePathPlaceholder.context: Empty save profile path input placeholder.

settings.invalidSavePath.context: Inline warning when save detection found no usable files.
settings.invalidSavePath.tone: Diagnostic; mention required files may be missing.

settings.currentProfile.context: Settings profile selector visible label and trigger accessible name.

settings.selectProfile.context: Profile trigger fallback when no profile id is selected.

settings.inRaid.context: Small destructive badge beside profiles with an active raid.
settings.inRaid.lengthHint: Very short badge, ideally under 12 characters.

settings.noProfiles.context: Empty profile-selector panel after detection yields no locations.

settings.autoBackup.context: Toggle label and accessible switch name for backup before each save.

settings.autoBackupHelp.context: Help under the automatic-backup toggle label.

settings.creating.context: Create Backup button while its request is pending.

settings.createBackup.context: Button that immediately creates an editor backup for current profile.

settings.openBackupFolder.context: Button opening the editor backup directory in the file manager.

settings.restoring.context: Backup-row Restore button while that backup request is in progress.

settings.restoreGameBackup.context: Button and dialog title for restoring the game-owned backup/ folder.
settings.restoreGameBackup.tone: Explicitly distinguish the game backup from editor backups.

settings.recentBackups.context: Subheading above timestamped editor backup rows.

settings.noBackups.lengthHint: Two short sentences in a wrapping row.

settings.backupFiles.context: File-count and raw profile-id line in each backup row and restore confirmation.
settings.backupFiles.lengthHint: Compact metadata line; wraps if needed.
settings.backupFiles.tone: Factual plural count; profile is an opaque id, preserve verbatim.

settings.restore.context: Backup-row button opens confirmation; destructive dialog button executes the selected restore after confirmation.
settings.restore.lengthHint: Very short action label on both buttons.
settings.restore.tone: Direct action; surrounding confirmation explains overwrite.

settings.darkMode.context: Dark-mode toggle label and accessible switch name.

settings.version.context: Label beside the app version badge in About.

settings.disclaimer.context: Amber About notice disclaiming official affiliation and responsibility.
settings.disclaimer.lengthHint: Wrapping paragraph in a 640 px card; preserve full meaning.
settings.disclaimer.tone: Formal disclaimer; retain product and company names.

settings.repository.context: Repository link in About; app code owns the destination and wraps translated link text.
settings.repository.tone: Neutral navigation label; retain GitHub brand.

settings.restoreBackup.context: Modal title when confirming a selected editor backup.

settings.restoreDescription.context: Selected-backup modal description before the file-change summary.
settings.restoreDescription.tone: Safety text; current files on disk will be replaced.

settings.checkAgain.context: Button rerunning restore preflight after a blocked result.

settings.restoreWarning.context: Amber warning inside selected-backup restore modal.
settings.restoreWarning.tone: Preserve safety-backup guarantee and loss of unsaved in-memory edits.

settings.restoreConfirm.context: Checkbox text required before either restore can run.
settings.restoreConfirm.tone: Explicit acknowledgement that current save files are overwritten.

settings.cancel.context: Cancel buttons in both restore dialogs.

settings.gameRestoreDescription.context: Game-backup restore modal description, before preflight summary.
settings.gameRestoreDescription.tone: Factual; backup/ is a literal folder name.

settings.gameRestoreWarning.context: Amber warning inside game-owned backup restore modal.
settings.gameRestoreWarning.tone: Preserve backup source, safety backup and loss of unsaved edits.

settings.restoreOutcome.context: Preflight file-change summary appended to either restore modal description.
settings.restoreOutcome.lengthHint: Complete wrapping sentence; both counts must stay in the same message.
settings.restoreOutcome.tone: Precise safety information; adds/removes count files, addsText is formatted adds.

settings.gameDetected.context: Success toast title after a detected installation path is applied.
settings.gameDetected.lengthHint: Short toast title; path shown separately.

settings.noGame.context: Error toast title when installation scan finds nothing.

settings.browseHelp.context: Toast description for empty installation or save detection.

settings.detectionFailed.context: Error toast title when either path scan throws.

settings.savesDetected.context: Success toast title after save-profile detection and selection.

settings.noSaves.context: Error toast title when save detection finds no locations.

settings.gamePanel.context: Native directory picker title for choosing a game installation.
settings.gamePanel.lengthHint: OS dialog title, one line if possible.

settings.savePanel.context: Native directory picker title for choosing a save profile folder.
settings.savePanel.lengthHint: OS dialog title, one line if possible.

settings.gameLoadFailed.context: Error toast when browsing/changing the game installation throws; raw diagnostic follows.
settings.gameLoadFailed.tone: Failure; do not hide the raw diagnostic.

settings.profileLoadFailed.context: Error toast when browsing/changing a profile throws; raw diagnostic follows.
settings.profileLoadFailed.tone: Failure of the selected profile load.

settings.profileLoaded.context: Success toast after choosing a detected profile.

settings.profileFailed.context: Error toast after profile-selector load throws; raw diagnostic follows.
settings.profileFailed.tone: Failure, no claim that edits were saved.

settings.backupCreated.context: Success toast after manual editor backup creation.

settings.backupFailed.context: Error toast for manual backup creation; raw diagnostic follows.
settings.backupFailed.tone: Failure; no claim of backup protection.

settings.openBackupFailed.context: Error toast when opening editor backup folder fails.
settings.openBackupFailed.tone: Folder-open failure; does not imply backup corruption.

settings.restoreUnavailable.context: Persistent error toast when restore preflight throws; raw diagnostic stays copyable.
settings.restoreUnavailable.tone: Safety failure; restoring has not started.

settings.backupRestored.context: Success toast after selected editor backup restore and reload.

settings.restoreFailed.context: Persistent error toast if either restore workflow fails; raw diagnostic follows.
settings.restoreFailed.tone: Safety failure; preserve recovery detail separately.

settings.gameBackupRestored.context: Success toast after game-owned backup restore and profile reload.

settings.profilesFound.context: Pluralized description below save-detection success toast.

settings.profileSwitched.lengthHint: One short sentence with raw profile id.

settings.restoredFrom.context: Description below selected-backup restore success toast.
settings.restoredFrom.lengthHint: One wrapping sentence with formatted timestamp.
settings.restoredFrom.tone: Completed restore; timestamp is already formatted.

settings.sourceManual.context: Small badge in profile selector for manually configured locations.

settings.sourceGog.context: Small profile-source badge for GOG saves.

settings.sourceEpic.context: Small profile-source badge for Epic saves.

settings.sourceSteam.context: Small profile-source badge for Steam saves.

common.close.context: Accessible close-button name for translated Settings restore dialogs.

common.closeToast.context: Sonner dismiss-button accessible name for notifications, including persistent errors.

settings.blockedDiagnostic.context: Inline restore-blocker alert in either confirmation modal; raw backend reason stays visible.
settings.blockedDiagnostic.lengthHint: Wrapping diagnostic; never truncate recovery paths.
settings.blockedDiagnostic.tone: Verbatim diagnostic; presence keeps Restore disabled.

settings.gameTextFailed.context: Settings fallback alert and layout persistent toast after game-text loading fails.
settings.gameTextFailed.lengthHint: Wrapping sentence naming requested and retained effective languages.
settings.gameTextFailed.tone: Clear failure with honest fallback; names are autonyms, not inflected.

settings.developmentVersion.context: Fallback beside the Settings version label when the native app version is unavailable in development.
settings.developmentVersion.lengthHint: Short version badge, ideally under 14 characters.
